reasoning: This icon depicts four arrows pointing inward, the standard UI chrome symbol for 'exit fullscreen' or 'collapse/minimize'. Because it represents an interface state toggle rather than a concrete real-world object or common to-do subject, it is only loosely applicable to metaphorical tasks like compressing files or downsizing and is easily confused with its outward-pointing counterpart.
